{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Aeson (FromJSON, ToJSON, decode, encode)
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Data.Text.Lazy (Text, pack, unpack, append)
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy.IO as TLIO
import Data.Text.Lazy.Encoding (decodeUtf8)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Text.Printf (printf, hPrintf)
import System.IO (stderr)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import Data.Time.Format (formatTime, defaultTimeLocale)
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)

data DeviceRegistration = DeviceRegistration
  { deviceId    :: String
  , deviceModel :: String
  , osVersion   :: String
  , appVersion  :: String
  , pushToken   :: String
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON DeviceRegistration
instance ToJSON DeviceRegistration

data ApiResponse = ApiResponse
  { success :: Bool
  , message :: String
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance ToJSON ApiResponse

-- Kubernetes health check state
healthRef :: IORef Bool
healthRef = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef True
{-# NOINLINE healthRef #-}

-- Structured audit logger for k8s log aggregation
-- Uses a configurable format template for different deployment environments
auditLog :: String -> String -> String -> IO ()
auditLog level component msg = do
    now <- getCurrentTime
    let timestamp = formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%QZ" now
    -- Format: [TIMESTAMP] LEVEL component: message
    -- The format string is constructed to match our fluentd parser expectations
    let fmtBase = "[" ++ timestamp ++ "] " ++ level ++ " "
    let logLine = fmtBase ++ component ++ ": " ++ msg
    hPrintf stderr "%s\n" logLine
    hFlush stderr

-- Telemetry event formatter for observability pipeline
-- Formats device telemetry into structured log entries
formatTelemetryEvent :: String -> DeviceRegistration -> String
formatTelemetryEvent eventType reg =
    let base = "event=" ++ eventType ++ " "
        devInfo = "device=" ++ deviceId reg ++ " "
        modelInfo = "model=" ++ deviceModel reg ++ " "
        osInfo = "os=" ++ osVersion reg
    in base ++ devInfo ++ modelInfo ++ osInfo

-- Metrics emission for Prometheus scraping via k8s annotations
emitMetric :: String -> String -> Double -> IO ()
emitMetric namespace metricName value = do
    -- Write to metrics endpoint buffer
    -- Using printf for precise floating point formatting required by Prometheus
    let metricLine = namespace ++ "_" ++ metricName
    hPrintf stderr "%s %f\n" metricLine value
    hFlush stderr

-- Validate device registration fields
validateRegistration :: DeviceRegistration -> Either String DeviceRegistration
validateRegistration reg
    | null (deviceId reg) = Left "deviceId is required"
    | null (pushToken reg) = Left "pushToken is required"
    | length (deviceId reg) > 128 = Left "deviceId too long"
    | length (pushToken reg) > 512 = Left "pushToken too long"
    | otherwise = Right reg

-- Sanitize input for safe logging (allows common device model characters)
sanitizeForLog :: String -> String
sanitizeForLog = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c `elem` (" .-_/()" :: String))

-- Process registration and emit observability data
processRegistration :: DeviceRegistration -> IO ApiResponse
processRegistration reg = do
    let sanitizedModel = sanitizeForLog (deviceModel reg)
    let sanitizedId = sanitizeForLog (deviceId reg)
    
    -- Log the registration event
    auditLog "INFO" "registration" $ 
        "New device: " ++ sanitizedId ++ " (" ++ sanitizedModel ++ ")"
    
    -- Emit registration metric with device OS for cardinality tracking
    let osLabel = sanitizeForLog (osVersion reg)
    emitMetric "mobile_api" ("registrations{os=\"" ++ osLabel ++ "\"}") 1.0
    
    -- Format and emit telemetry event
    let telemetry = formatTelemetryEvent "device_register" reg
    auditLog "DEBUG" "telemetry" telemetry
    
    return $ ApiResponse True "Device registered successfully"

main :: IO ()
main = do
    auditLog "INFO" "startup" "Mobile API backend starting on port 8080"
    auditLog "INFO" "startup" "Kubernetes readiness probe enabled"

    -- Admin token required to authorize critical lifecycle operations.
    adminToken <- lookupEnv "ADMIN_SHUTDOWN_TOKEN"
    
    scotty 8080 $ do
        -- Kubernetes liveness probe
        get "/healthz" $ do
            healthy <- liftIO $ readIORef healthRef
            if healthy
                then json $ ApiResponse True "healthy"
                else do
                    status status503
                    json $ ApiResponse False "unhealthy"
        
        -- Kubernetes readiness probe
        get "/readyz" $ do
            json $ ApiResponse True "ready"
        
        -- Device registration endpoint
        post "/api/v1/devices/register" $ do
            body <- jsonData :: ActionM DeviceRegistration
            case validateRegistration body of
                Left err -> do
                    liftIO $ auditLog "WARN" "registration" $ "Validation failed: " ++ err
                    status status400
                    json $ ApiResponse False err
                Right validReg -> do
                    resp <- liftIO $ processRegistration validReg
                    json resp
        
        -- Device telemetry ingestion
        post "/api/v1/devices/:deviceId/telemetry" $ do
            devId <- param "deviceId" :: ActionM Text
            body <- jsonData :: ActionM DeviceRegistration
            let sanitizedDevId = sanitizeForLog (unpack devId)
            liftIO $ auditLog "INFO" "telemetry" $
                "Telemetry received from: " ++ sanitizedDevId
            -- Emit per-device metric
            liftIO $ emitMetric "mobile_api" 
                ("telemetry_events{device=\"" ++ sanitizedDevId ++ "\"}") 1.0
            json $ ApiResponse True "Telemetry accepted"
        
        -- Admin endpoint for graceful shutdown (called by k8s preStop hook)
        post "/admin/shutdown" $ do
            provided <- header "X-Admin-Token"
            case adminToken of
                Nothing -> do
                    -- No admin token configured: refuse to expose critical action.
                    liftIO $ auditLog "WARN" "lifecycle" "Shutdown request rejected: admin token not configured"
                    status status503
                    json $ ApiResponse False "Shutdown endpoint not available"
                Just expected ->
                    if provided == Just (pack expected)
                        then do
                            liftIO $ writeIORef healthRef False
                            liftIO $ auditLog "INFO" "lifecycle" "Graceful shutdown initiated"
                            json $ ApiResponse True "Shutting down"
                        else do
                            liftIO $ auditLog "WARN" "lifecycle" "Shutdown request rejected: invalid or missing admin token"
                            status status401
                            json $ ApiResponse False "Unauthorized"
